name: 스펙트럼 나이퀴스트 분석
description: Analyzes the frequency spectrum at Nyquist boundaries to detect upsampling artifacts. AI models often produce spectral peaks at these frequencies that are absent in real photos.
mechanism:
The 분석 process involves several stages:

1. **2D FFT Transform**: Converts the image from 공간 영역 to 주파수 영역 using 2D Fast 푸리에 Transform.

2. **High-frequency 스펙트럼 분석**: 조사합니다 spectral energy around the Nyquist frequency (f/2). Neural network image generators (GANs, Diffusion models) use upsampling layers (bilinear, nearest-neighbor, transposed convolution) that create characteristic frequency 아티팩트.

3. **Periodic peak 감지**: 식별합니다 periodic energy peaks in the frequency 스펙트럼 — a hallmark signature of upsampling in decoder/generator architectures.

4. **Spectral comparison**: 비교합니다 the frequency energy 분포 against natural spectral models. Camera images have natural high-frequency rolloff due to optics, while AI images show abnormal energy 분포s.
parameters:
Transform: 2D FFT (radix-2), Analysis region: Nyquist band ±10%, Metrics: high/low frequency energy ratio, periodic peak 계수, spectral 기울기

Analysis size: full image + 256x256 blocks
Normalization: logarithmic 스펙트럼, azimuthal averaging
accuracy: 높음 - 80-90% for AI images with upsampling 아티팩트. Particularly effective for GAN-generated images (StyleGAN, ProGAN) due to heavy use of upsampling layers.
source: Durall et al. (2020) Watch your Up-Convolution, CVPR 2020
useCase: Detection of frequency 아티팩트 from generative networks and upsampling. Especially effective with GAN images and AI-upscaled images.

references.title: Zhang, X. et al. (2019). Detecting and Simulating Artifacts in GAN Fake Images. IEEE WIFS.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.

strengths:
• Effectively 감지 GAN-specific upsampling 아티팩트
• Content-independent 분석
• Difficult to forge as it relates to fundamental frequency characteristics
• Works well with uncompressed or lightly compressed images
limitations:
• Effectiveness decreases with heavy JPEG 압축
• Some newer Diffusion models produce fewer spectral 아티팩트
• Real images that have been resized may produce 오탐
• Not effective with small images (< 256x256)
